messages.subject: Order confirmation - 12 filing cabinets
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lim,

Thank you for your order of 12 four-drawer filing cabinets. Delivery is scheduled for next Tuesday between 9am and 12pm.

Best regards,
Aiman

messages.subject: Re: Order confirmation - 12 filing cabinets
messages.body:
Nobody showed up on Tuesday. I took the morning off to wait for your lorry and nobody even called. Please tell me what happened.

Gregory

messages.subject: Re: Order confirmation - 12 filing cabinets
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lim,

We are very sorry. Our lorry broke down on the way and our driver failed to inform you. We have rescheduled the delivery to this Friday morning.

Best regards,
Aiman

messages.subject: Re: Order confirmation - 12 filing cabinets
messages.body:
The cabinets arrived on Friday, but 3 of them have dented drawers and one lock does not work at all. This is the second time your company has let me down.

I want these replaced this week. Otherwise I will cancel the shelving order we discussed and ask for a refund on the cabinets.

Gregory Lim

deals.title: 仓库货架与办公室家具

messages.body: 你好，我是国伟五金的郑先生，朋友介绍的。我们仓库要换一批货架，办公室也想顺便换桌椅。
郑先生您好，谢谢您找我们！请问仓库大概多大？货架主要放什么货？
仓库大概 3000 平方尺，主要放水管配件和五金零件，有些箱子蛮重的。
明白，那建议用重型货架，每层承重 300 公斤的。方便的话我可以安排同事去量一下。
可以，星期四下午方便吗？
星期四下午 3 点可以，我和同事一起过去。
今天谢谢你们过来。量好了吗？大概要几组？
量好了，初步算要 18 组重型货架，另外办公室 8 张办公桌、8 张椅子和 2 个文件柜。我整理好报价再发给您。
好的。椅子我比较在意，同事每天坐很久，要好一点的。
了解，我会放两款人体工学椅给您选。如果需要，样品椅子可以先借您试坐一个星期。
那很好，样品什么时候可以送来？
这个星期六我顺路送过去。
报价收到了，42800 有点超出预算。我们原本预算是 38000 左右。
明白。我回去和经理商量看能不能调整，也可以把部分货架换成中型的。
中型的够用吗？我怕放重的箱子会弯。
最下面两层放重的箱子用重型，上面放轻的零件用中型，这样比较省。
这个方案可以考虑。你们的货架有保修吗？
货架结构保修五年，椅子保修两年。
好。那修改后的报价什么时候可以给我？
我星期五之前把修改后的报价发给您，同时附上两款椅子的资料。
样品椅子星期六收到了，同事说那款黑色的坐起来比较舒服。
太好了，那报价我就用黑色那款来算。
说好的修改报价还没收到哦，我们下星期一开会就要决定了。
另外想问，如果月底前签约，安装可以在下个月第一个星期完成吗？

messages.subject: 询问会议室家具
messages.body:
您好，

我们事务所下个月搬到新办公室，需要一张可坐十人的会议桌（连椅子）和一个前台接待柜，麻烦提供报价。

李佩珊

messages.subject: 回复：询问会议室家具
messages.body:
李小姐您好，

报价如下：十人会议桌连十张椅子，加前台接待柜，合计 RM 23,600。我们答应为贵所免费送货与安装，另外赠送一块会议室白板。

如有问题请随时联系。

messages.subject: 回复：询问会议室家具
messages.body: 谢谢。合伙人同意这个价钱，但想确认会议桌的颜色能不能做胡桃木色。

messages.subject: 回复：询问会议室家具
messages.body:
李小姐您好，

可以做胡桃木色，交货期会多一个星期。免费送货安装与赠送白板照旧。

messages.subject: 回复：询问会议室家具
messages.body:
好的，那我们就确定胡桃木色。

想再问三件事：订金要付多少？付款后多久可以交货？上次说送的白板，可以换成一个小书柜吗？

李佩珊

deals.title: Clinic waiting area, reception and staff room furniture

messages.subject: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body:
Hello,

We are opening a second clinic and need furniture for the waiting area (about 20 seats), a reception counter and a staff room. Could you advise?

Dr Martin Ong

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body:
Dear Dr Ong,

Thank you for reaching out. Could you share the floor area and your preferred style? We can then propose a layout.

Aiman

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body: The waiting area is roughly 450 sq ft. We prefer a clean, bright look that is easy to wipe down. The staff room needs a dining table for 6 and lockers for 10.

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body: Noted. For a clinic we recommend vinyl upholstery, which is easy to disinfect. I will prepare two layout options.

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body:
Dear Dr Ong,

Here are the two layout options. Option A uses 4 rows of linked beam seating (20 seats). Option B mixes single armchairs and two-seater sofas (18 seats).

Aiman

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body: Thanks. We like Option B but need at least 20 seats. Can you add two more chairs?

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body: Yes, we can add two armchairs to bring Option B to 20 seats.

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body: Great. What colours are available for the vinyl?

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body: We have grey, teal, sand and navy. I will courier fabric swatches to the clinic so you can see them in person.

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body: Swatches received, thank you. We are choosing between teal and grey.

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body: Also, the reception counter must have a lower section for wheelchair users. Is that possible?

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body: Certainly. We can build a lowered section, 76 cm high, on the left side of the counter.

messages.subject: Re: Furniture for new clinic
messages.body: Good. Please send the quotation for Option B with 20 seats, the reception counter and the staff room items.

messages.subject: Quotation - Seri Molar Dental Clinic
messages.body:
Dear Dr Ong,

The total for Option B (20 seats), the reception counter with the lowered section, a 6-seat dining set and 10 lockers is RM 31,750.00. Delivery takes about four weeks after the deposit is paid.

Aiman

messages.subject: Re: Quotation - Seri Molar Dental Clinic
messages.body: That is a bit above what we planned. Is there any flexibility on price?

messages.subject: Re: Quotation - Seri Molar Dental Clinic
messages.body: I checked with my manager. If you confirm by the end of this month, we can include free installation and waive the delivery charge.

messages.subject: Re: Quotation - Seri Molar Dental Clinic
messages.body: Okay. My partner, Dr Chua, wants to see the lockers before deciding. Do you have them in your showroom?

messages.subject: Re: Quotation - Seri Molar Dental Clinic
messages.body: Yes, the lockers are on display. Dr Chua is welcome any weekday from 10am to 6pm.

messages.subject: Re: Quotation - Seri Molar Dental Clinic
messages.body: Dr Chua visited and liked the lockers. We have decided on teal for the seating.

messages.subject: Re: Quotation - Seri Molar Dental Clinic
messages.body: Wonderful, I have noted teal. I will send the final quotation with the colour updated.

messages.subject: Re: Quotation - Seri Molar Dental Clinic
messages.body: We have not received the final quotation yet. Also, can the reception counter top be in white solid surface instead of laminate? What would be the price difference?

messages.subject: Re: Quotation - Seri Molar Dental Clinic
messages.body:
One more thing: our opening date is fixed, so please confirm whether delivery in four weeks is still possible if we pay the deposit next week.

Dr Martin Ong
